title: Chromasync Config
description: Defines sync profiles and records where configured targets write generated artifacts. Auto-managed in part by `chromasync target install` at ~/.config/chromasync/config.toml. Read by the generate, wallpaper, batch, and sync commands so configured targets write to their recorded output_dir instead of the generic output fallback.

configs.description: Runnable sync profiles selected by `chromasync sync [name]`.

targets.description: Target output entries. Empty when no target has been configured yet.

hooks.description: Commands run after successful sync generation events.

syncProfile.description: One row under [[configs]] describing a syncable theme generation profile. Exactly one of seed, image, or image_fetch_command must be set.

name.description: Profile name selected by `chromasync sync [name]`. `chromasync sync` without a name selects `default`.

seed.description: Hex seed color. Mutually exclusive with image and image_fetch_command.

image.description: Wallpaper image path. Relative paths are resolved from the config.toml directory. Mutually exclusive with seed and image_fetch_command.

image_fetch_command.description: Shell command run from the config.toml directory whose first non-empty stdout line is a wallpaper image path. Relative output paths are resolved from the config.toml directory. Mutually exclusive with seed and image.

template.description: Template name (built-in lookup) or path to a .toml template file. Relative paths are resolved from the config.toml directory.

mode.description: Theme mode. auto detects the current GNOME color-scheme with gsettings and falls back to dark.

chroma.description: Chroma strategy used when generating palette families.

targets.description: Target names (built-in, installed, or pack-provided) or target TOML paths. Relative paths are resolved from the config.toml directory.

output_dir.description: Fallback output directory for targets without a [[targets]] entry. Relative paths are resolved from the config.toml directory.

force.description: When true, sync overwrites existing artifacts for targets that do not have their own overwrite setting.

target.description: One row under [[targets]] mapping a target to its output directory and overwrite flag.

name.description: Target name. For custom targets, this matches the name field of a discovered target TOML. Built-in targets such as kitty, alacritty, ghostty, hyprland, hyprland-lua, and zed can also be mapped here.

output_dir.description: Directory where this target's generated artifacts are written. A leading ~ or ~/ expands to the user's home directory at resolve time.

source.description: Optional location of the installed target file relative to the config root, such as "targets/gtk.toml". Omit for built-in targets.

overwrite.description: When true, generation overwrites existing artifacts for this target (a per-target --force). A global --force or sync profile force=true overrides this regardless of the recorded value.

hook.description: One command hook under [[hooks]]. Hooks currently run after successful `chromasync sync` artifact writes.

name.description: Human-readable hook name used in error messages.

on.description: Event or events that trigger this hook. Supported events are `targets:done` and `target:<target-name>:done`.

command.description: Shell command run from the directory containing config.toml. A non-zero exit status fails the sync command after artifacts have been written.

filters.description: Optional filters. Currently supports `config:<profile-name>`; all filters must match.
